build_griffinlim_vocoder: build a GriffinLimVocoder from data config to synthesize waveforms from mel spectrograms
build_hifigan_vocoder: build a HiFiGANVocoder from checkpoint and config to generate waveforms from mel spectrograms
build_codehifigan_vocoder: build a CodeHiFiGANVocoder from checkpoint and config to generate waveforms from discrete codes
run_get_vocoder: run get_vocoder to instantiate a vocoder by type such as griffin_lim or hifigan
run_codehifigan_from_pretrained: run CodeHiFiGANVocoder.from_pretrained to load a pretrained vocoder model from the fairseq hub
